operations.title: Exact orbit-2 balanced branch null-jet checker
The orbit-2 balanced rank drop is not a corank-two complex-square branch
operations.summary: At phi=0 and equal edge-product balance the exact invariant Jacobian has rank 9, not 8; kernel and cokernel are one-dimensional.

operations.title: The straight intrinsic null jet of the orbit-2 balanced degeneration begins at quartic order
operations.summary: The exact cokernel-projected restriction along the Jacobian null line has coefficients 0 at orders 2 and 3, 16 at order 4, 0 at order 5, and 32/3 at order 6. This is compatible with a corank-one A3-type degeneration but does not establish the normal form before Lyapunov-Schmidt elimination.

operations.title: Perform exact Lyapunov-Schmidt reduction of the orbit-2 balanced invariant map
operations.summary: Eliminate the nine range directions order by order and compute the reduced scalar germ through at least quartic order before constructing a linking monodromy loop.
